description: MIBiG 3.1 biosynthetic-class vocabulary mapped to MIBiG 4.0. Null means the 3.1 term has no direct counterpart in 4.0 and its entries were reclassified.
retired_terms_note: 4.0 has no alkaloid class. Entries carrying it in 3.1 were reclassified, most into 'other', sometimes alongside a retained class.
